episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis:
It's summer break so Tsuda and the rest of the Student Council take a camping trip to a deserted island.

Some time is spent with the Judo Club where they train with a new doll.

Back in Tsudas house where they study and make ice cream.
